description: Remove one or more nodes (and their descendants) from a scene file. Always-array: pass a single-element nodePaths array for one-off deletes. Saves once at the end. Cannot delete the scene root - that entry returns an error and the rest still process. Returns: results array with one entry per nodePath in input order (success or error message). Errors while a Godot runtime session is active on this project; stop_project (or detach_project) clears it.

nodePaths.description: Node paths from scene root to delete (e.g. ["root/Player/Sprite2D"])

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Scene file path relative to the project (e.g. "scenes/main.tscn")

name: delete_nodes
